expectations.text: Every addSql() has the /** @lang MySQL */ marker
SQL is unchanged apart from backticks and whitespace (same tokens as the input)
Code outside the SQL strings (getDescription, docblocks, parameter arrays) is unchanged, apart from removing the Doctrine auto-generated comments
expectations.evidence: identical ignoring whitespace and the generated comments

expectations.text: Table names and SET/CREATE TABLE column names are backticked
Column names inside each CREATE TABLE are aligned
SQL bodies start on their own line (multi-line layout)
$this->addSql(, /** @lang MySQL */, the first SQL line and the closing quote all start at the same indent
Each CREATE TABLE has an empty line between the columns and the indexes/keys, and an empty line before the closing parenthesis
expectations.evidence: all CREATE TABLE blocks ok (or none)

expectations.text: Consecutive $this->addSql() calls are separated by one empty line
No Doctrine auto-generated comments remain (no "Auto-generated Migration" docblock, no "this up()/down() migration is auto-generated" lines)
Each foreign key is split over lines: ADD CONSTRAINT <name>, then FOREIGN KEY, REFERENCES and each ON DELETE/ON UPDATE on their own deeper lines
